file: 124 The Biggest Brainrot Games on ROBLOX.mp4

lines.t: These are the five biggest brainrot games on Roblox, ranked by the most people playing at once.

full.credit: Image: Steal a Brainrot on Roblox

lines.t: Number 5: Swing Obby for Brainrots. You swing across ropes and grab brainrots. It peaked around 256,000 players in March 2026.

full.credit: Image: Swing Obby for Brainrots on Roblox

lines.t: Number 4: Kick a Lucky Block, by No More Flops. Kick a block to roll brainrots, train your legs, and survive a tsunami. 1.7 million at once, in May 2026.

full.credit: Image: Kick a Lucky Block on Roblox

lines.t: Number 3: Escape Tsunami for Brainrots. Outrun a giant wave while you collect brainrots. It hit 4.1 million in February 2026.

full.credit: Image: Escape Tsunami for Brainrots on Roblox

lines.t: Number 2: Plants and Brainrots. Your plants fight brainrots for you. 8.7 million at once, in October 2025.
And number 1: Steal a Brainrot. Over 25 million people playing at once, in October 2025.

full.credit: Image: Steal a Brainrot on Roblox

lines.t: That's about three times number 2, and almost a hundred times number 5.
It also has nearly 70 billion visits, the second most visited Roblox game ever.
Next: the game that took Steal a Brainrot's crown. Subscribe so you don't miss it.
